short_english_summary: Canada’s trade tribunal opened an expiry review of its 2022 order on Chinese carbon and alloy steel line pipe. Border officials will assess whether dumping or subsidizing may resume; the tribunal will then assess likely injury to Canadian producers.

Canada will invest $15 million in Xona’s $64.8 million Montréal satellite navigation project. The planned centre will develop and manufacture positioning systems intended to strengthen domestic defence capacity, resilient navigation and Arctic operations.

Canada’s trade tribunal opened an expiry review of its 2021 finding on small power transformers from Chinese Taipei and Korea. Border officials will assess whether dumping may resume; the tribunal will then assess likely injury to Canadian producers.
